title: Ladakh protest enters second day, Wangchuk claims 'under house arrest'

ai.summary: Ladakh protests continue as climate activist Sonam Wangchuk faces house arrest for two months, demanding deferment of hill council polls until May-June 2027 due to winter conditions and release of a judicial inquiry report into September 2025 violence.

facts.quote: The Leh Apex Body's (LAB) indefinite dharna has entered a second day defying restrictions imposed by Ladakh administration on protests and sit-ins

facts.claim: Wangchuk faces house arrest for two months
facts.quote: Wangchuk was taken away from the dharna site on Wednesday evening by police and shifted to his residence, where he has been kept under house detention.

facts.claim: Demanding deferment of hill council polls until May-June 2027
facts.quote: Dorjay said "December is not the right time to hold elections in Ladakh"

facts.claim: Release of judicial inquiry report into September 2025 violence
facts.quote: They also sought release of the inquiry report into September 24, 2025 violence in Leh, in which four people were killed and more than 40 injured in police firing.

ai.background_note: Ladakh protests demand deferment of hill council polls until May-June 2027 due to winter conditions and release of a judicial inquiry report into September 2025 violence in Leh.

problems: number 2027 in the summary does not appear in the article
